home_intro: Set up the consent banner, keep a record of every choice and stay in control of the scripts your sites load.
not_found_body: Check the address, or go back to the start.
email_footer: This email was sent automatically by CloveConsent.
email_link_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
email_verify_intro: Confirm your email address to finish creating your CloveConsent sign-in.
email_verify_ignore: If you did not sign up for CloveConsent, you can ignore this email.
email_reset_intro: We received a request to reset the password of your CloveConsent sign-in. The link works only for a short time.
email_reset_ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email: your password stays the same.
email_invitation_intro: {inviter} invited you to join the account {account} on CloveConsent.
email_invitation_ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
email_two_factor_enabled_intro: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your CloveConsent sign-in.
email_two_factor_disabled_intro: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your CloveConsent sign-in. Signing in now needs only your password.
email_new_sign_in_subject: New sign-in to your CloveConsent account
email_new_sign_in_intro: Your CloveConsent account was signed in to on {when} from {device}.
email_new_sign_in_if_you: If this was you, there is nothing to do.
email_security_not_you: If this was not you, reset your password and review your security settings right away.
auth_password_hint: At least 12 characters. Passwords known from data breaches are refused.
auth_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth_error_invalid_credentials: The email address or password is wrong.
auth_error_email_not_verified: Confirm your email address first: open the link we emailed you, or ask for a new one.
auth_error_password_length: The password must have 12 to 128 characters.
auth_error_password_compromised: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
auth_error_passwords_differ: The two passwords are not the same.
auth_error_user_exists: This email address cannot be used to sign up.
auth_error_link_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth_error_challenge_expired: This sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
auth_error_locked: Too many wrong codes. Sign-in is blocked for a while; try again later.
auth_error_session_expired: Please sign in again to do this.
auth_error_passkey_cancelled: The passkey was not used. Try again when you are ready.
auth_error_passkey_failed: The passkey could not be checked. Try again or sign in with your password.
verify_email_sent: Check your inbox: we sent you a link to confirm your email address. It works for 24 hours.
verify_email_intro: Enter your email address and we will send the confirmation link again.
verify_email_done: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify_email_resent: If this address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.
forgot_password_intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_password_sent: If an account uses this address, a link is on its way. It works for one hour.
reset_password_done: Your password is changed and every signed-in browser was signed out. Sign in with the new password.
two_factor_intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the code it shows for CloveConsent.
two_factor_use_app: Use the code from the app instead
security_two_factor_off: Two-factor authentication is off. Turn it on to be asked for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
security_two_factor_scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
security_two_factor_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
security_two_factor_secret: Or enter this key in the app by hand:
security_backup_codes_intro: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
security_passkeys_intro: A passkey signs you in with the screen lock of your device or a security key, without a password or code.
accounts_new_intro: An account holds your sites and the people who work on them. You will be its owner.
accounts_new_name_hint: For example, your company's name. Up to 100 characters.
accounts_new_error_name: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
members_invite_intro: We email them a link that is valid for 7 days. They accept it signed in with that address.
members_error_last_owner: An account must keep at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
members_error_owner_only: Only an owner can change an owner or make someone an owner.
members_error_not_pending: This invitation is no longer pending.
members_error_already_member: This person is already a member.
members_error_already_invited: This address already has a pending invitation.
invite_signed_out: To accept this invitation, sign in with the email address it was sent to.
invite_sign_up_link: New here? Sign up with that address, then open the link again.
invite_pending: You are invited to join {account} as {role}.
invite_state_not_found: This invitation link is not valid. Check that you opened the whole link from the email.
invite_state_wrong_email: This invitation was sent to another email address. Sign out and sign in with the address it was sent to.
invite_state_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite_state_used: This invitation has already been used.
invite_state_already_member: You are already a member of this account.
accounts_new_error_limit: You have created {max} accounts, the most one person can create. Contact us if you need more.
members_error_limit_pending: This account has too many pending invitations. Cancel some, or wait until they are answered or expire.
members_error_limit_account_day: This account has sent as many invitations as it can today. Try again tomorrow.
members_error_limit_user_day: You have sent as many invitations as you can today. Try again tomorrow.
paywall_heading: This account has no active plan
paywall_none: The product opens once the account is paid for. Online payment is not available yet: contact us and we will activate your plan.
paywall_necessary_only: The plan of this account ended, and its grace period ended on {date}. Published sites run only what is necessary. Contact us to renew the plan.
paywall_active: The plan of this account is active.
sites_grace: The plan of this account has ended. Everything keeps working until {date}; contact us to renew it.
admin_accounts_search_label: Name, account id or member email
admin_account_paid_until_label: Paid through (the end of this day, UTC)
admin_account_suspension_intro: A suspended account enters its {days}-day grace period at once.
admin_impersonate_intro: You can view the account as one of its members: read-only, for {minutes} minutes, recorded in the audit log.
admin_error_reason: Give a reason, up to 500 characters.
admin_error_date: Enter a day between the years 2000 and 2100.
admin_error_limited: Too many changes in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
admin_error_impersonation: The view could not be opened.
admin_audit_filtered: Events of one account. {count} newest shown.
impersonation_banner: You are viewing the app as {name} ({email}), read-only, until {time} UTC. Nothing can be changed.
security_session_support_view: Support view (read-only, opened by our support)
